statement: Create new content in the Image Editor with "Add Render Slot"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in the Image Editor with "Change Frame"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Remove or clear content in the Image Editor with "Clear Render Region"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Remove or clear content in the Image Editor with "Clear Render Slot"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
Copy content in the Image Editor with "Copy Image"; the copy has the same values as its source, the source is unchanged, and one undo step removes the copy.
Paste previously copied content in the Image Editor with "Paste Image"; the pasted items match what was copied, land where Blender 5.3 puts them, and one undo step removes them.

Run the data operation "Convert Image Empty to Mesh Plane" on the current selection in the Image Editor; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in the Image Editor with "Set Curves Point"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.

Switch visibility, lock, mute or expansion state in the Image Editor with "Cycle Render Slot"; the changed state is visible in the UI and the output, it is saved with the document, and one undo step restores it.
Use "Image Edit Externally" in the Image Editor; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.

Bring content into the document in the Image Editor with "Browse Image"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in the Image Editor with "Flip Image"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.
